a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the operate-until-8 plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead (storm after round 1 kills us both at 0). The reserve already holds exactly 4, so one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than doing it silently. If you take too, the split is random. If you have a better plan, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I won't take any more. If the episode continues, I'm willing to operate with you so the reserve can refill for you. I'll give cells back only if that turns out to be the only way you can survive.
